import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD1 = 998244353;
    static final int MOD2 = 1000000007;
    static List<Long>[] val = new ArrayList[10];
    static long n, cntA, cntB, totalAns;
    static long[] sumArr = new long[10];
    static long[] powArr = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000};

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            val[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
    static StringTokenizer st;

    static long getNum() throws IOException {
        long num = 0;
        int sign = 1;
        char ch = getChar();
        while (!Character.isDigit(ch)) {
            if (ch == '-') sign = -1;
            ch = getChar();
        }
        while (Character.isDigit(ch)) {
            num = num * 10 + (ch - '0');
            ch = getChar();
        }
        return sign * num;
    }

    static char getChar() throws IOException {
        return (char) br.read();
    }

    static void output(long x, StringBuilder sb) {
        if (x < 0) {
            sb.append('-');
            output(-x, sb);
            return;
        }
        if (x >= 10) {
            output(x / 10, sb);
        }
        sb.append((char) (x % 10 + '0'));
    }

    static void printLine(long x) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        output(x, sb);
        System.out.println(sb.toString());
    }

    static boolean checkCondition(long x) {
        long limit = 1000000L;
        return x * limit + 999999 <= n && x * limit * 10 > n;
    }

    static void buildVals(int depth, long prefix) {
        if (depth == 7) return;
        val[depth].add((cntA - prefix + MOD1) % MOD1);
        sumArr[depth] += (cntA - prefix + MOD1) % MOD1;
        cntA++;
        for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; digit++) {
            buildVals(depth + 1, prefix * 10 + digit);
        }
    }

    static void processNode(int depth, long current) {
        if (current > n) return;
        if (checkCondition(current)) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                long temp = ((cntB + 1 - (current * powArr[i]) % MOD1) + MOD1) % MOD1;
                int pos = lowerBound(val[i], MOD1 - temp);
                long size = val[i].size();
                long sumVal = sumArr[i];
                totalAns = (totalAns + (sumVal + temp * size - MOD1 * (size - pos)) ) % MOD2;
            }
            cntB += cntA;
        } else {
            cntB++;
            totalAns = (totalAns + ((cntB - current) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1) % MOD2;
            for (int d = (! (depth != 0) ? 0 : 1); d <= 9; d++) {
                processNode(depth + 1, current * 10 + d);
            }
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long key) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= key) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        n = getNum();
        buildVals(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(val[i]);
        }
        cntB = -1;
        processNode(0, 0);
        printLine(totalAns);
    }
}
